string-array.name: whats_new_highlights
string-array.item: App Launcher Quick Shortcuts (Log Progress, New Goal, Week Pace, Dynamic Pinned Goal)
Fixed Precise Time Toggle across all dashboard card styles (1h 15m vs 1.25 hrs)
Immutable History Log ledger (removed accidental log deletion capabilities)
Android Home Screen Glance Widget with dynamic opacity, theme modes, and shape radiuses
Visual Pinned Star Badge overlay on circular goal icon containers
Performance optimizations, bug fixes, and Material 3 Expressive UI polish
